BUG-698.description: FY preset returns PREVIOUS financial year (Apr 2025 - Mar 2026) instead of CURRENT FY (Apr 2026 - Mar 2027)
BUG-698.rca: Bug in /app/frontend/src/utils/datePresets.js line 52. Formula: fyEndYear = month>=3 ? year : year-1. When month=Nov(10), fyEndYear=2026, so from=new Date(2025,3,1)=Apr 2025, to=new Date(2026,2,31)=Mar 2026 (PREVIOUS FY). Fix: const fyStartYear = now.getMonth() >= 3 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1; return { from: fmtISO(new Date(fyStartYear, 3, 1)), to: fmtISO(new Date(fyStartYear + 1, 2, 31)) };

BUG-698.current_code: const fyEndYear = now.getMonth() >= 3 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1; return { from: fmtISO(new Date(fyEndYear - 1, 3, 1)), to: fmtISO(new Date(fyEndYear, 2, 31)) };
BUG-698.expected_code: const fyStartYear = now.getMonth() >= 3 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1; return { from: fmtISO(new Date(fyStartYear, 3, 1)), to: fmtISO(new Date(fyStartYear + 1, 2, 31)) };
BUG-698.explanation: When current month >= April (month index 3), fyEndYear should be NEXT year (e.g., 2027 for FY Apr2026-Mar2027), not current year (2026). The variable name 'fyEndYear' is misleading — it's actually computing fyStartYear logic but using it as end year.
